# DontSpeak

> A local voice layer for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Codex: your AI agent speaks its
> replies aloud through a local neural voice, and you dictate back with one key. It runs a
> native host app (speech engine in-process, on-device models) plus an MCP server that any
> MCP-capable client can call. Models download on first launch.

To install, tell your agent: `Install DontSpeak.org app.` It detects the OS and runs the
matching installer — prebuilt binaries only, no source build. Start a new Claude Code
session afterward so it picks up the MCP server. macOS: grant Accessibility + Microphone
on first launch. Linux: run the one-time `sudo` udev step the installer prints (for
Caps-Lock capture).

Every install carries its own full uninstaller — macOS/Linux:
`~/.local/bin/dontspeak-uninstall`; Windows: Settings > Apps > DontSpeak (or
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DontSpeak\uninstall.ps1`).

## Source
